queries.purpose: Find safe APM metadata for the exact run UUID or known hash
queries.sql:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS at_utc,
    service_name AS service,
    if(match(name, '^(daemon|mikka|workflow)[.][a-z0-9_.]{1,100}$'), name, 'other_stage_redacted') AS stage,
    status_code,
    duration_nano / 1000000 AS duration_ms,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(trace_id))) AS trace_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex,
    if(attributes['error.type'] IN ('Error', 'CodedError', 'TypeError', 'RangeError', 'SyntaxError', 'AbortError', 'TimeoutError', 'FetchError'), attributes['error.type'], 'absent_or_other') AS error_type,
    if(match(attributes['mikka.error.code'], '^(subscription_[a-z_]+|ERR_[A-Z_]+|E[A-Z]+|[a-z]+(_[a-z]+){1,8})$'), attributes['mikka.error.code'], 'absent_or_redacted') AS error_code,
    if(match(attributes['mikka.error.detail'], '^[a-z]+(_[a-z]+){1,8}$'), attributes['mikka.error.detail'], 'absent_or_redacted') AS error_detail,
    length(attributes['mikka.error.causes']) > 0 AS safe_causes_present,
    position(attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'TypeError') > 0 AS cause_has_typeerror,
    position(attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'ENOENT') > 0 AS cause_has_enoent,
    position(attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'ECONNREFUSED') > 0 AS cause_has_econnrefused
FROM posthog.trace_spans
WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-07 04:26:35', 'UTC')
    AND timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-07 04:27:05', 'UTC')
    AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
    AND (
        attributes['mikka.run.id_hash'] = 'cfbe8eb3c7ea6fcb'
        OR attributes['mikka.run_id'] = 'f879d6cd-bdbd-4e62-9a17-441f1f763a25'
    )
ORDER BY timestamp, span_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT
    'log' AS source,
    formatDateTime(l.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%S.%fZ', 'UTC') AS at_utc,
    l.service_name AS service,
    if(match(l.attributes['mikka.stage'], '^(daemon|mikka|workflow)[.][a-z0-9_.]{1,100}$'), l.attributes['mikka.stage'], 'other_stage_redacted') AS stage,
    NULL AS status_code,
    toFloatOrNull(l.attributes['mikka.duration_ms']) AS duration_ms,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(l.span_id))) AS span_id_hex,
    if(l.attributes['error.type'] IN ('Error', 'CodedError', 'TypeError', 'RangeError', 'SyntaxError', 'AbortError', 'TimeoutError', 'FetchError'), l.attributes['error.type'], 'absent_or_other') AS error_type,
    if(match(l.attributes['mikka.error.code'], '^(subscription_[a-z_]+|ERR_[A-Z_]+|E[A-Z]+|[a-z]+(_[a-z]+){1,8})$'), l.attributes['mikka.error.code'], 'absent_or_redacted') AS error_code,
    if(match(l.attributes['mikka.error.detail'], '^[a-z]+(_[a-z]+){1,8}$'), l.attributes['mikka.error.detail'], 'absent_or_redacted') AS error_detail,
    length(l.attributes['mikka.error.causes']) > 0 AS safe_causes_present,
    position(l.attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'TypeError') > 0 AS cause_has_typeerror,
    position(l.attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'ENOENT') > 0 AS cause_has_enoent,
    position(l.attributes['mikka.error.causes'], 'ECONNREFUSED') > 0 AS cause_has_econnrefused
FROM logs AS l
WHERE l.timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-11-07 04:26:35', 'UTC')
    AND l.timestamp < toDateTime('2026-11-07 04:27:05', 'UTC')
    AND l.service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
    AND l.trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('4d9fe13db9eec64004a6d1e1fa47088e'))
ORDER BY at_utc, source, span_id_hex
LIMIT 100
